Targeted scroll-difference note — מ:הערה-2

← Back to Reading MAM-parsed-plus

מ:הערה is the standard (non-targeted) scroll-difference note: it carries the note text but does not explicitly identify which word the note applies to. “Targeted” version מ:הערה-2 wraps the target word:

{
  "tmpl_name": "מ:הערה-2",
  "tmpl_params": {
    "1": "מִנְּשֹֽׂא",
    "2": "בספרי ספרד ואשכנז מִנְּשֽׂוֹא",
    "3": "אאא*"
  }
}

Arguments:

  1. The target word (the word the note applies to)
  2. The note text (the scroll-difference description)
  3. Mark position: "אאא*" means the note marker (star) comes after the target; "*אאא" means it comes before (only Deut 22:6).

The מ:הערה template is retained alongside מ:הערה-2. The plus format redundantly keeps both representations. This is by design: some downstream consumers use מ:הערה-2 only to extract the target word and use מ:הערה separately to extract the note text.

Example in context

[
  "וַיֹּ֥אמֶר קַ֖יִן אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה גָּד֥וֹל עֲוֺנִ֖י ",
  {
    "tmpl_name": "נוסח",
    "tmpl_params": {
      "1": {
        "tmpl_name": "מ:הערה-2",
        "tmpl_params": {
          "1": "מִנְּשֹֽׂא",
          "2": "בספרי ספרד ואשכנז מִנְּשֽׂוֹא",
          "3": "אאא*"
        }
      },
      "2": [
        "...", {"tmpl_name": "ש"}, "..."
      ]
    }
  },
  {
    "tmpl_name": "מ:הערה",
    "tmpl_params": {
      "1": "בספרי ספרד ואשכנז מִנְּשֽׂוֹא",
      "שם": "בספרי ספרד ואשכנז מִנְּשֽׂוֹא"
    }
  },
  "׃"
]
